urls.rationale: ADMINISTRATION subdivision (24-1-101 — 24-19.9-103) covers Article 6 Part 3 (Lobbyist Registration and Reporting, §§ 24-6-301 to 24-6-309) and Article 18.5 (Independent Ethics Commission, §§ 24-18.5-101 et seq.) — the full CO lobbying-disclosure regime.

notes: CO Title 24 splits its 31 articles into directory clusters at the title page; lobbying-disclosure articles all fall under the ADMINISTRATION cluster. Pass 3 will drill into administration/ to surface Article 6 (and Article 18.5 if exposed).
